list.name: board
list.query:
SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM boards
WHERE id LIKE 'linear:%' OR id LIKE 'jira:%'
ORDER BY name
list.label: Issue board

list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(r.name), LEFT(w.repo_id, 8)) AS __text, w.repo_id AS __value FROM whodunit_commits w LEFT JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = w.commit_sha LEFT JOIN repos r ON r.id = rc.repo_id GROUP BY w.repo_id ORDER BY __text
list.label: Repository (commit panels)

options.content:
AI in engineering, on one screen

How much of the work is AI-assisted, whether the agent's edits are being kept, whether assisted work ships faster, and whether quality held. Every figure has a filter above it and a tooltip behind it; the numbers here are the same ones on the executive dashboard, drawn so the trend is visible before the figure.

Assisted and unassisted work are self-selected — people reach for an agent on some tasks and not others — so every comparison is a difference, not an effect. Commits with no evidence collected are shown as their own band, never folded into either side.

panels.title: Adoption
panels.description:
Share of commits in the selected range carrying `status=assisted`.

**Adoption is not coverage.** Coverage beside it counts any valid trailer including `undetermined` — a repository at full coverage may have had no agent involvement at all. Coverage says the instrumentation works; this says the agents are being used.

The delivery dashboard carries the same figure; both follow the time range.

defaults.noValue: No commits in the selected range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.status='assisted')*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS v
FROM whodunit_commits c
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                         AND $__unixEpochTo()   * 1000000000

panels.title: Acceptance

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(e.outcome='accepted')/NULLIF(SUM(e.outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','failed')),0),1) v FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor WHERE ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR e.repo_id = '${repo:raw}') AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000

panels.description:
Share of decided tool calls that were accepted.

**The denominator is decided calls only** — accepted, rejected or failed — not all calls. A call whose outcome was never recorded is excluded rather than counted as accepted, which would flatter the rate. See Decided tool calls beside this for the size of that denominator.

A rejection is a human declining; a failure is the tool erroring. Both count as decided, and only acceptance is in the numerator.

panels.title: Median cycle time, hours
panels.description: Median hours from issue open to done, for issues whose commits were AI-assisted against those that were not, on the selected board. Withheld below 5 issues a side. A difference between self-selected cohorts, not an effect — the assisted side may simply be the easier work.

         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')

  AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)

        (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(i2.issue_key,'-',1)
           FROM issues i2 JOIN board_issues bi2 ON bi2.issue_id = i2.id
          WHERE bi2.board_id = '$board'
            AND i2.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' LIMIT 1),
        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
HAVING ai = 1) ca) < 5
           OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
  AND i.lead_time_minutes > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'

HAVING ai = 0) cb) < 5

         ELSE (SELECT ROUND(AVG(ltm)/60, 1) FROM (
                 SELECT ltm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ltm) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () cnt
                 FROM (SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL

  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
  AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP CONCAT('^',
        (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(i2.issue_key,'-',1)
           FROM issues i2 JOIN board_issues bi2 ON bi2.issue_id = i2.id
          WHERE bi2.board_id = '$board'
            AND i2.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' LIMIT 1),
        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
HAVING ai = 1) c) r
               WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2)))
       END) AS value
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Not AI-assisted', (SELECT CASE
         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i

        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
HAVING ai = 1) ca) < 5
           OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha

GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
HAVING ai = 0) cb) < 5
         THEN NULL

FROM issues i

WHERE bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL

panels.title: People using it
panels.description: Contributors with at least one AI-assisted commit in range, against everyone who committed. People, not licences.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN COALESCE(wi.canonical,c.contributor) END) AS `Using AI`,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(wi.canonical,c.contributor)) AS `Active`
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')

panels.title: Three signals as bands
panels.description: Each row is one signal per week, coloured by threshold: adoption (green from 50%), acceptance of the agent's edits (green from 90%), and the fix share of assisted commits (green under 25%, red from 40%). Read across a row for the trend, down a column for a bad week. Grey means no data, or no assisted commits yet, that week.

targets.rawSql:
WITH wc AS (
  SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) DAY) w,
         100*SUM(c.status='assisted')/COUNT(*) adoption,
         100*SUM(c.purpose='fix' AND c.status='assisted')/NULLIF(SUM(c.status='assisted'),0) rework
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}') GROUP BY w),
we AS (
  SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1000000000)) DAY) w,
         100*SUM(e.outcome='accepted')/NULLIF(SUM(e.outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','failed')),0) acceptance
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR e.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  GROUP BY w)
SELECT CAST(wc.w AS DATETIME) AS time,
       ROUND(wc.adoption,0) AS `Adoption`,
       ROUND(we.acceptance,0) AS `Acceptance`,
       ROUND(wc.rework,0) AS `Rework, assisted`
FROM wc LEFT JOIN we ON we.w = wc.w ORDER BY time

panels.title: Commits per week, by evidence
panels.description: Every commit, stacked: AI-assisted, unassisted, and no evidence collected. The grey band is the honest third state — the tool was absent or could not say, which is not the same as no AI. Adoption is the green share of each bar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) DAY) AS DATETIME) AS time,
       SUM(c.status='assisted') AS `AI-assisted`,
       SUM(c.status='unassisted') AS `Unassisted`,
       SUM(CASE c.status WHEN 'undetermined' THEN 1 WHEN 'uninstrumented' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'unmatched' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No evidence`
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Issues opened vs closed

targets.rawSql:
SELECT IF('$grain'='%Y-%m-%d',  days.d,
    IF('$grain'='%x-W%v', DATE(days.d - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(days.d) DAY),
                        DATE(days.d - INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(days.d)-1 DAY))) AS `time`,
       NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(o.opened, 0)), 0) AS `opened`,
       NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(c.closed,  0)), 0) AS `closed`
FROM (
  SELECT DATE(i.created_date) d FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id = '$board' AND i.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  UNION
  SELECT DATE(i.resolution_date) FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id = '$board' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.status = 'DONE' AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
) days
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DATE(i.created_date) d, COUNT(*) opened FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id = '$board' AND i.created_date IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) GROUP BY d
) o ON o.d = days.d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DATE(i.resolution_date) d, COUNT(*) closed FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id = '$board' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    AND i.status = 'DONE' AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY d
) c ON c.d = days.d
GROUP BY `time`
ORDER BY `time`

defaults.noValue: No issues opened or closed on this board in the selected range

panels.description:
Issues opened and closed per period, on the selected board.

**Closed means closed in that period, whatever period it was opened in.** Measured here, 141 of 240 issues over three months — so the bars are not a matched pair and the gap between them is not this period's arithmetic.

Scoped by issue board rather than repository: an issue is reachable from a repository only through its commits, and most issues have none — 109 of 379 here. A repository filter would silently drop the rest.

panels.title: Issues closed, cumulative
panels.description: Running total of issues closed on the selected board, one line per cohort. Cumulative lines make the pace visible as a slope: steeper is faster. The assisted line starts when adoption did.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       SUM(COALESCE(`AI-assisted`,0)) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS `AI-assisted`,
       SUM(`not AI-assisted`) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS `Not AI-assisted`
FROM (SELECT IF('$grain'='%Y-%m-%d', DATE(i.resolution_date),
          IF('$grain'='%x-W%v', DATE(i.resolution_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY),
                                DATE(i.resolution_date - INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(i.resolution_date)-1 DAY))) AS `time`,
       NULLIF(SUM(t.ai = 1), 0) AS `AI-assisted`,
       SUM(t.ai = 0) AS `not AI-assisted`
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT i.issue_key,
       i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       i.resolution_date,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE w.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
  AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP CONCAT('^',
        (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(i2.issue_key,'-',1)
           FROM issues i2 JOIN board_issues bi2 ON bi2.issue_id = i2.id
          WHERE bi2.board_id = '$board'
            AND i2.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' LIMIT 1),
        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes, i.resolution_date
) t ON t.issue_key = i.issue_key
WHERE bi.board_id = '$board' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `time` ORDER BY `time`) r

panels.title: Where AI is used, and how deeply
Share of each kind of work that is AI-assisted
panels.description: Each bar is one kind of work at 100%, split by evidence. Reads as: of the features, how much was assisted. Features and fixes are where the argument is; docs and tests being assisted is cheaper to believe and worth less.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.purpose AS metric,
       SUM(c.status='assisted') AS `AI-assisted`,
       SUM(c.status='unassisted') AS `Unassisted`,
       SUM(CASE c.status WHEN 'undetermined' THEN 1 WHEN 'uninstrumented' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'unmatched' THEN 1 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No evidence`
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}') AND c.purpose IN ('feature','fix','refactor','test','docs','chore')
GROUP BY c.purpose ORDER BY FIELD(c.purpose,'feature','fix','refactor','test','docs','chore')

panels.title: How deeply the agent is used

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN s.mcp_calls > 0 OR s.distinct_tools >= 5 OR s.tool_calls >= 50
              THEN 'agentic'
         WHEN s.tool_calls > 0 THEN 'edits'
         ELSE 'chat only'
       END AS `depth`,
       COUNT(*) AS `sessions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000
                      AND $__unixEpochTo()   * 1000000000
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR s.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
GROUP BY `depth`
ORDER BY FIELD(`depth`, 'chat only', 'edits', 'agentic')

panels.description:
Sessions by how far they went: **chat only** made no tool calls, **edits** made some, **agentic** used MCP or ran 5+ distinct tools or 50+ calls.

Depth is not value. A long agentic session and a one-question chat can both be exactly what the work needed.

panels.title: Cycle time per week, each cohort
panels.description: Mean hours from issue open to done each week, one bar per cohort. Weeks with issues on one side only show one bar. The gap between bars is the headline; a gap that narrows as adoption grows says the early assisted issues were the easy ones.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(t.resolution_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(t.resolution_date) DAY),'%b %d') AS week,
       DATE(t.resolution_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(t.resolution_date) DAY) AS ord,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.ai=1 THEN t.ltm END)/60,1) AS `AI-assisted`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.ai=0 THEN t.ltm END)/60,1) AS `Not AI-assisted`
FROM (
SELECT i.issue_key,
       i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       i.resolution_date,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE w.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
  AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP CONCAT('^',
        (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(i2.issue_key,'-',1)
           FROM issues i2 JOIN board_issues bi2 ON bi2.issue_id = i2.id
          WHERE bi2.board_id = '$board'
            AND i2.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' LIMIT 1),
        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes, i.resolution_date
) t
WHERE t.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND t.ltm > 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.resolution_date)
GROUP BY week, ord ORDER BY ord

panels.title: How cycle time is distributed
panels.description: Every closed issue, binned by hours to done, one distribution per cohort. A median hides the tail; this shows it. Issues over 400 hours are cut from the plot for readability.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN t.ai=1 THEN t.ltm/60 END AS `AI-assisted`,
       CASE WHEN t.ai=0 THEN t.ltm/60 END AS `Not AI-assisted`
FROM (
SELECT i.issue_key,
       i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
       i.resolution_date,
       COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN issue_commits c ON c.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = c.commit_sha
WHERE w.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  bi.board_id = '$board'
  AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
  AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP CONCAT('^',
        (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(i2.issue_key,'-',1)
           FROM issues i2 JOIN board_issues bi2 ON bi2.issue_id = i2.id
          WHERE bi2.board_id = '$board'
            AND i2.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' LIMIT 1),
        '-[0-9]+$')
GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes, i.resolution_date
) t
WHERE t.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND t.ltm > 0 AND t.ltm/60 <= 400 AND $__timeFilter(t.resolution_date)

panels.title: Rework rate, each side
panels.description: Share of commits that are fixes, assisted against unassisted. Speed that comes back as rework is not speed. A fix rate, not a defect rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.purpose='fix')/COUNT(*),1) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  AND ('${repo:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.repo_id = '${repo:raw}')
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1
GROUP BY c.status HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

options.content: Reading this honestly. Adoption is a share of commits, not of people or hours. Acceptance counts the agent's edits that were kept, not whether they were good. Cycle time compares issues whose commits were assisted against those that were not, on the same board, and withholds a figure below five issues a side. Rework is a fix rate — commits labelled fix — not a defect rate. Nothing here measures time saved.
